Q1: How should repeated dispatch failures on the same PR be handled?
Choices:
A. Hold with no limit. Every later review run tries the dispatch again and logs a warning. No marker is written and nothing escalates, so a consumer wrapper without `pr_number` blocks every eligible PR until that wrapper is synced.
B. Count each failed dispatch as a used cycle. The gate posts a `status=failed` marker for the current head with the next cycle number, using the existing marker format, and holds. Later review runs retry. Once `MAX_SECURITY_PASS_CYCLES` is used up, the existing exhaustion path labels the PR `ai:security-pass-failed` (RECOMMENDED)
C. Add a separate dispatch-failure counter with its own cap, a new env var with a default. When the cap is reached, label the PR `ai:security-pass-failed`. Audit cycles stay separate from dispatch failures.
